title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to create a new item from a picture/image (Out-of-the-Box)
summary: Business Central has an out-of-the-box New from picture action, found under the arrow next to New on the Items page, that creates an item from an uploaded image. The image is analyzed to pick a fitting item category and suggest a template, the user fills in item attribute values, and on OK the item is created with the picture attached and a description based on the image file name.
key_points: New from picture sits in the dropdown next to New on the Items page; first use asks for confirmation
The uploaded image is analyzed to choose a suitable item category and suggest a template; the category stays blank if nothing fits
The user completes the item attribute values before confirming, and these are saved with the new item
The new item gets the picture automatically, a description containing the source image name, and other fields from the chosen template

objects.name: Select a template for a new item

quotes.text: We can actually create an item directly from a picture/image.
quotes.why_it_matters: This highlights the key feature being discussed - an alternative method to create items beyond the standard template approach.

quotes.text: The system will automatically select the most suitable Category based on the image and suggest a Template to apply.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core automation benefit of the feature that saves time and reduces manual data entry.
